title: FACTORY_CONSUMER_SUBSET_V1 (projection of ProjectBlueprintV1 schema_version 1.1)
description: Producer contract. Fields beginning with '_' are internal and must be ignored. Unknown extra fields must be ignored. This schema describes structure only; materialization readiness additionally requires technology_decision.status == CONFIRMED and a supported profile mapping (see profile-mapping-v1.json).

schema_version.description: Checked FIRST. Supported values: '1.1'. Any other string = UNSUPPORTED_BLUEPRINT_SCHEMA; missing or non-string = INVALID_BLUEPRINT.

target_platforms.description: May legitimately be empty when the user did not specify platforms; a consumer must not require it to be non-empty.

then.description: V1 accepts CONFIRMED only from an explicit user-confirmed stack. An inferred source can never be CONFIRMED.

required_decisions.description: Informational. NOT authoritative for the technology decision: technology readiness is read from technology_decision.status only.
